subject.title: fix: parse provider rate-limit reset timestamps for smarter cooldowns

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded free-form provider reset-text parsing as default auth-profile cooldown behavior, or require a typed provider reset-hint contract first?
rationale: The code defects are repairable, but the permanent behavior choice can change existing users' provider availability for hours or days after upgrade and needs auth-provider policy intent.

options.title: Repair and accept bounded text parsing
options.body: Fix rawError propagation, CI/lint/test issues, keep strict clamps, and require redacted real-run proof before merge.

options.title: Require typed reset hints first
options.body: Pause this branch and design a provider-owned reset metadata path before writing long cooldowns from provider text.

options.title: Defer to broader quota work
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and let the overlapping quota circuit-breaker work settle classification and cooldown policy first.

recommendation.title: Repair and accept bounded text parsing
recommendation.body: Fix rawError propagation, CI/lint/test issues, keep strict clamps, and require redacted real-run proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent auth-profile usage/cooldown contributor in the inspected history.
